drums.description: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences, A distorted, resonant kick drum drives the rhythm at 130 BPM in 4/4 time, A syncopated, metallic percussion loop provides high-frequency energy, A gritty, monophonic synth bassline follows a 16th-note pattern with frequent filter modulation, Dark, atmospheric pads with long release times create a dense background texture, A sharp, staccato lead synth enters with a repetitive minor-key motif, Occasional white noise sweeps and industrial foley hits punctuate the transitions, The track maintains a consistent, driving energy with subtle automation on the percussion's decay and the synth's resonance Publish
